products.name: Veed.io AI
products.note: Online video editing AI; auto-subtitle; text-to-speech; UK-hosted

reading.body:
Veed is a UK-based video editing platform that bundles multiple AI models and APIs into a single interface, rather than building proprietary video generation capabilities.

The company's strategy is aggregation. Veed.io AI integrates third-party models like Sora, Veo, and Kling alongside its own tools for subtitle generation, text-to-speech, and dubbing. This positions the platform as a workflow layer that handles hosting and user experience while outsourcing the compute-intensive work of video generation to other providers. For end users, this consolidation reduces friction. For the infrastructure question, it means Veed's own power and cooling demands sit primarily in serving the API calls and storing edited outputs, not in training or running the largest models.

The developer API offering reveals a different constraint. Veed exposes lip sync, avatar generation, and subtitle APIs, suggesting it sees recurring demand for specific video production steps. This is consistent with video becoming more central to AI applications, but the data does not indicate scale of usage or which of these APIs consume the most resources. The UK hosting note confirms a regional infrastructure choice, though the data does not explain the reasoning.

What remains unclear is whether Veed's model represents opportunity or fragility for AI infrastructure planning. If the platform thrives, demand for underlying model inference grows. If it fails, it consumed neither exceptional power nor rare buildout. The data shows the company exists and what it offers, not whether it matters to the grid.

profile_text.body:
Veed is a London, England based company founded in 2018, according to the profile information held on it. Its website presents it as an AI video creation platform, describing a workflow that runs from idea to finished video, and says it is built for marketers and solopreneurs. The site lists a broad set of tools under that umbrella, including an AI video generator, text to video, image to video, AI avatars, dubbing, text to speech, a clip generator, an AI reel generator, a voice generator, and an AI video editor. Editing features named on the site include automatic subtitle generation, caption generation, video translation, background removal, background noise removal from audio and video, a teleprompter, eye contact correction, screen recording, and video compression.

The site also names a number of third-party and in-house video models it works with, among them Fabric 1.0, Sora 2, Veo 3.1, and Kling AI, alongside VideoGPT and AI Avatars. It advertises a set of AI video APIs, listing a Fabric 1.0 API, Lip Sync API, Lip Sync 2.0 API, Subtitle API, Background Removal API, Background Removal Fast API, Green Screen API, and a Live Avatar API that the site marks as a waitlist.

The product tracked for Veed is Veed.io AI, in the video generation and editing category, described as online video editing AI with auto-subtitle and text-to-speech, hosted in the UK. No litigation is recorded for the company.
